parameters.excerpt: For each ``x``INH bit, if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero.
parameters.reasoning: Each xINH bit (MINH, SINH, UINH, VSINH, VUINH) in mhpmevent is read-only zero when the associated privilege mode is not implemented. This is an implementation choice about which privilege modes are supported, which determines which INH bits are writable vs. read-only-zero. This is a NORM_CSR_RW parameter because it controls the RO/RW nature of specific bits in the mhpmevent CSR.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: The OF bit is set when the corresponding hpmcounter overflows, and remains set until written by software.
